name: hostel-mess-management
description: SKAI Hostel Mess Management System - Food Reviews, Menu Planning, Polls, Inventory & Food Waste Analytics

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,inventory" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "node server.js"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/copy-inventory.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
